question: Glass, Lit tag and Highlighter (boxed) still score under the professional bar after three reworks. Keep all ten chip styles, or drop those three?
context: On 2026-10-31 you approved all ten chip styles; the task's own checklist also says every style must score as professional with a judge. Three judges now pass Squircle and Spec badge, put Solid, Hairline, Paper and Lit tag at 6, and Glass and Highlighter at 4.

options.label: Keep all ten as reworked
options.summary: The Chip row keeps its ten tiles with today's new Glass, Spec badge and Highlighter. The judge bar is set aside for these three and the task closes.
pros: Keeps every style you approved on 2026-10-31
Glass now really frosts the picture behind it in the app
cons: Three judges still rate Glass and Highlighter 4 of 10
options.mitigation: You can drop any tile later by saying so; nothing else depends on them.

options.label: Drop the three boxed styles
options.summary: The Chip row shows seven tiles: Glass, Lit tag and Highlighter leave it. An arrow that already wears one keeps drawing it.
pros: Every tile left scores 5 or more, most 6 or 7
A shorter row is quicker to pick from
cons: Loses three looks you approved, Glass included
options.mitigation: The three stay in the code so old documents draw unchanged.

options.label: Rework the three again
options.summary: Another pass designs new looks for Glass, Lit tag and Highlighter and asks the judges again. The row stays at ten.
cons: Three passes have not; judges disagree with each other by two points
options.mitigation: A pass would start from the judges' notes in this task's log.
